summary: Update 8:36 am: Trey Murphy III is OUT for New Orleans, which moves Utah to about 40% - Utah is a small bet only at 2.60 or better. Washington-Atlanta and Philadelphia-Detroit are live; Washington remains a thin lean at 2.20+. Everything else on the slate is priced about fair.

Trey Murphy III ruled OUT (knees) after being listed probable, so New Orleans loses its top projected scorer; Yves Missi also out. Pre-news lines had Utah +180 to +200; expect that to shorten.

pick.reason: Murphy out moves Utah to about 40%; worth it only at 2.60+.
